records.evidence: Firsthand played Rabbit Jump/Azumarill and Jolteon+Manectric. Own Jolteon+Manectric deck had excellent disruption/mobility, but Manectric damage is insufficient and Jolteon gets KO; has stopped using it as often. Reports Sylveon draw/support with Rocket Slowking and early Gengar. Pikachu/Alolan Raichu ex hypothetical pairing is NOT credited as tested.
records.body_summary: 本人实战：Rabbit Jump/玛力露丽；雷伊布+雷电兽干扰与机动性好，但伤害不足、易被击倒；仙子伊布辅助抽牌。未实测的皮卡丘及阿罗拉雷丘 ex 配对不计实战。
